entities.name: Tōru Iwatani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tōru Iwatani  is a Japanese video game designer who spent much of his career working for Namco. He is best known as the creator of the arcade game Pac-Man (1980). In 2009, Iwatani was chosen by IGN as one of the top 100 game creators of all time.

entities.name: Tōru Iwatani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tōru Iwatani  is a Japanese video game designer who spent much of his career working for Namco. He is best known as the creator of the arcade game Pac-Man (1980). In 2009, Iwatani was chosen by IGN as one of the top 100 game creators of all time.
